task.title: Auto-handle empty commits in worker rebase flow
task.summary_zh: 修正 worker 跑 git pull --rebase 遇到 # empty pick 會卡 approval queue 的問題。設計 rebase_helper module 自動帶 --allow-empty 或 --skip 策略，supervisor.py 改用 helper 1 行替換。獨立 helper module 與 OPS-REFACTOR-001 不衝突。
acceptance: rebase_helper.py exposes continue_or_skip_empty(repo_path) returning RebaseResult dict with action in {continued skipped aborted_with_conflict}
implementation auto-skips empty commits and re-runs continue until rebase finishes or hits non-empty conflict
test covers 3 cases: clean continue all-empty skip and real conflict bail-out
supervisor.py change is exactly 1 import + 1 call site
task.next: Finalized after task commit c9f61449; verified PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_rebase_helper.py -q => 4 passed and git diff --cached --check => clean. Unrelated dirty worktree entries remain outside this task.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過；所有 acceptance criteria 驗證 pass。supervisor 整合精確 1 import + 1 call site，rebase_helper 安全機制完備（200 步上限、GIT_EDITOR=true、衝突偵測涵蓋 UU/AA/DD）。無 blocking 問題。

commit_metadata.Verified: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_rebase_helper.py -q => 4 passed; git diff --cached --check => clean

handoffs.message: Ready for review: added .orchestrator/rebase_helper.py with continue_or_skip_empty(repo_path) RebaseResult API; auto-skips empty rebase picks until completion, aborts on real conflicts or failed skip/continue, and handles worktree/.git-file git dirs. Added .orchestrator/test_rebase_helper.py covering clean continue, all-empty skip, conflict bail-out, and no-rebase no-op. Updated .orchestrator/rebase_helper_contract.md. Supervisor integration is exactly one import plus one call site in run_once before dispatch. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_rebase_helper.py -q => 4 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/rebase_helper.py .orchestrator/supervisor.py => passed.
Review approved: all acceptance criteria verified, 4 tests pass, supervisor integration is exactly 1 import + 1 call site. Returned to Codex for closeout finalization.
